Formal Notice — Scope of This System
Please read before using SNED-LINK+

1. Not a therapist replacement. SNED-LINK+ is a documentation and communication platform for teachers, parents, and specialists. It does not provide therapy, diagnosis, screening results, or clinical interpretation.

2. General, not clinical, language. All behavior descriptions, ratings, patterns, trends, and AI-assisted drafts are general classroom observations. They are not clinical measures and must not be read as symptoms, severity scores, or diagnostic indicators.

3. Purpose of the behavior log. Logs exist so a therapist or specialist can review what happened in class while they are not physically with the child. They supplement — never substitute for — direct professional observation and assessment.

4. Approval ≠ clinical validation. When a therapist marks a log as reviewed or approved, it means they received and read the teacher's record. It does not certify the content as a clinical finding or authorize any intervention on its own.

5. Parents. Information in the parent portal is for awareness and collaboration. Concerns should always be raised with a licensed professional. Nothing here should be used to self-diagnose a child.

Before you submit
Daily Behavior & Self-Regulation Observation Log
Disclaimer & Data Responsibility
This observation log is a teacher-recorded behavioral document, not a clinical or diagnostic instrument. The ratings, behavior episodes and AI-generated suggestions below do not diagnose any condition and must never replace assessment by a licensed SPED specialist, psychologist or physician.

By submitting you confirm that: (a) every entry reflects what was directly observed on the recorded date; (b) learner information is handled under the school's Data Privacy policy and shared only with authorized staff and the learner's parent/guardian; (c) AI recommendations are decision support only and remain subject to your professional judgment; and (d) the record becomes part of the learner's official portfolio and is auditable once submitted.
AI Recommendation auto-generated
Generated from this log's rating scale, behavior episodes, triggers and responses. Editable in the intervention field (see the Monthly Pattern Report).
